assets.content:
PRESS PDF — Lunara Chronometry authenticity & timing certificate 2025 (single card, 148 x 105 mm landscape, 3mm bleed, fonts embedded). Exactly as it went to the printer last season. To be reverse-engineered into a live InDesign merge template.

VISUAL STRUCTURE:
- Top-left: LUNARA CHRONOMETRY wordmark in the display serif (fixed, not merged).
- Right: a placed square PHOTOGRAPH of the piece.
- Under the wordmark, what reads on the printed card as FOUR separate stacked blocks (these convert into one continuous text flow, not four frames):
   Block 1  SERIAL & REFERENCE line, e.g. 'Serial LC-25-0101 / Meridian'
   Block 2  CALIBER & METAL line, e.g. 'Caliber LM-01 / Steel'
   Block 3  DIAL FINISH line, e.g. 'Silver sunburst'
   Block 4  TIMING & SIGN-OFF, e.g. 'Regulated +2 s/day by J.M.' followed by the fixed timing sentence.

MERGE FIELD LABELS (to be mapped from lunara_register.csv, computed by offset inside the single story):
<<serial>> <<reference>>  ->  Block 1
<<caliber>> <<case_metal>>  ->  Block 2
<<dial_finish>>  ->  Block 3
<<timing_result>> <<regulator_initials>>  ->  Block 4
<<image>>  ->  PHOTOGRAPH frame (bound through the @-prefixed image column)

FIXED WORDING (do not reword): 'Timed by hand and signed. This piece was regulated to the result above and released by the named regulator.'

NOTE FOR THE PRINTER: warm near-black ink #191512 on bone cream #EDE6D6, formal and calm. Card trim 148 x 105 mm.

assets.content:
LUNARA CHRONOMETRY — notes (client-supplied, approved)

FIVE REFERENCES
Meridian - hand-wound, silver sunburst dial, steel case & bracelet, mirror-polished.
Selene - automatic, grained cream dial, steel case & bracelet.
Ardent - hand-wound, lacquered oxblood dial, steel case on oxblood strap.
Halcyon - small-seconds, silver dial, steel case & bracelet.
Vesper - automatic, deep blue sunray dial, steel case on blue strap. (Keep ONE frame of a reference in true colour for the dial-finish page - use Vesper.)

CALIBERS
LM-01 - hand-wound, 42h reserve.
LM-02 - automatic, 48h reserve.
LM-03 - hand-wound, small seconds.

TREATMENT
One committed single-tone look across the whole campaign, WARM not blue, with fine grain so it reads as film not filter. One recipe carried across all nine frames. The dial-finish page frame stays true colour.

STORE & DEALERS
Store tiles: square, 2000 x 2000 px, watch centred with air, on clean white. Dealer variants: transparent, nothing behind the watch (dealers place them on their own panels).
Dealer panel colours: Dealer A oxblood #5A2A28, Dealer B warm near-black #191512.

CERTIFICATE WORDING (fixed, do not reword the timing line)
'Timed by hand and signed. This piece was regulated to the result above and released by the named regulator.'

BAND
$4,000-$12,000 a piece. Collector buyers 35-60. Confidence, not colour.
